question: Pandit Birju Maharaj was associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj **was associated with the **Kathak** dance form.
